pattern.name: idempotent_symlink
pattern.code:
# Create a symlink idempotently, backing up existing files # Arguments: # $1 - Source file (must exist) # $2 - Target link location # Returns: # 0 on success, 1 on failure create_symlink() { local source="${1:?Source path required}" local target="${2:?Target path required}" local backup_dir="${HOME}/.dotfiles_backup"
# Validate source exists if [[ ! -e "$source" ]]; then log_error "Source does not exist: $source" return 1 fi
# If target is already correct symlink, skip if [[ -L "$target" ]] && [[ "$(readlink "$target")" == "$source" ]]; then log_info "Symlink already exists: $target -> $source" return 0 fi
# Create parent directory if needed mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
# Backup existing file if it's not a symlink if [[ -e "$target" ]] && [[ ! -L "$target" ]]; then mkdir -p "$backup_dir" local backup_name backup_name="${backup_dir}/$(basename "$target").$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)" log_warning "Backing up existing file: $target -> $backup_name" mv "$target" "$backup_name" fi
# Remove existing symlink if pointing elsewhere if [[ -L "$target" ]]; then rm "$target" fi
# Create symlink ln -s "$source" "$target" log_success "Created symlink: $target -> $source" }

pattern.name: idempotent_directory
pattern.description: Create directory idempotently with proper permissions
pattern.code:
# Create directory with specified permissions, idempotently # Arguments: # $1 - Directory path # $2 - Permissions (optional, default: 755) ensure_directory() { local dir="${1:?Directory path required}" local mode="${2:-755}"
if [[ -d "$dir" ]]; then log_info "Directory already exists: $dir" return 0 fi
if [[ -e "$dir" ]]; then log_error "Path exists but is not a directory: $dir" return 1 fi
mkdir -p "$dir" chmod "$mode" "$dir" log_success "Created directory: $dir (mode: $mode)" }

pattern.name: idempotent_line_in_file
pattern.description: Ensure a line exists in a file
pattern.code:
# Ensure a line exists in a file # Arguments: # $1 - File path # $2 - Line to ensure # $3 - Comment for context (optional) ensure_line_in_file() { local file="${1:?File path required}" local line="${2:?Line content required}" local comment="${3:-}"
# Create file if it doesn't exist if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then touch "$file" fi
# Check if line already exists if grep -qxF "$line" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then log_info "Line already exists in $file" return 0 fi
# Add comment if provided if [[ -n "$comment" ]]; then echo "" >> "$file" echo "# $comment" >> "$file" fi
echo "$line" >> "$file" log_success "Added line to $file" }

secure_download
pattern.code:
# Download file securely with checksum verification # Arguments: # $1 - URL # $2 - Output file # $3 - Expected SHA256 checksum (optional) secure_download() { local url="${1:?URL required}" local output="${2:?Output file required}" local expected_checksum="${3:-}" local temp_file
temp_file=$(mktemp) trap 'rm -f "$temp_file"' RETURN
# Download with curl (prefer) or wget if command -v curl &>/dev/null; then curl -fsSL --max-time 60 "$url" -o "$temp_file" || { log_error "Download failed: $url" return 1 } elif command -v wget &>/dev/null; then wget -q --timeout=60 "$url" -O "$temp_file" || { log_error "Download failed: $url" return 1 } else log_error "Neither curl nor wget available" return 1 fi
# Verify checksum if provided if [[ -n "$expected_checksum" ]]; then local actual_checksum if command -v sha256sum &>/dev/null; then actual_checksum=$(sha256sum "$temp_file" | cut -d' ' -f1) elif command -v shasum &>/dev/null; then actual_checksum=$(shasum -a 256 "$temp_file" | cut -d' ' -f1) else log_warning "Cannot verify checksum: no sha256sum or shasum" fi
if [[ -n "${actual_checksum:-}" ]] && [[ "$actual_checksum" != "$expected_checksum" ]]; then log_error "Checksum mismatch!" log_error "Expected: $expected_checksum" log_error "Actual: $actual_checksum" return 1 fi fi
# Move to final location mv "$temp_file" "$output" log_success "Downloaded: $output" }
